insights.headline: Early signal, 12 applications: applications made through a referral tend to hear back more often than other methods.

findings.text: Out of 12 applications, applications made through a referral got a response 5 of 5 times, while everything else got a response 1 of 7 times. This looks like a helpful pattern so far.

suggestions.text: You might decide to focus more of your networking efforts on securing referrals for your upcoming applications.

insights.caveat: These insights remain uncertain because the numbers are small and applications may differ in unmeasured ways. Since 7 comparisons were checked, one of them standing out by chance is possible.
